headline: Severe storms tear roofs off and flood US streets as Thanksgiving holiday begins
label: NEWS
caption:
Roofs have been torn off and streets left under water as severe weather hits parts of the US. 🌊

According to the BBC, hundreds of thousands of people have been affected by the storms across the country. The severe weather arrived just as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend began.

Authorities and residents are dealing with the aftermath of the damaging winds and heavy flooding. More updates are expected as emergency services assess the damage.
